content.user_title: Add User Approval to Caffeine AI Apps
content.value_statement: Applications need a controlled process for granting access to protected features. This skill guides backend approval checks, admin decisions, and frontend approval workflows.
actual_capabilities: Integrates the prefabricated user approval module into a Motoko backend.
Defines endpoints for status checks, approval requests, user lists, and admin decisions.
Shows approval guards that preserve administrator access to protected functions.
Outlines a frontend flow for pending, approved, and rejected users.
Specifies an admin dashboard for approval decisions and role management.
limitations: Requires the Caffeine AI authorization extension and declared Mops dependencies.
Uses a prefabricated approval module that cannot be modified.
Provides integration guidance rather than complete application files.
Targets Caffeine AI applications with Motoko backends.

use_cases.title: Gate a New Application
use_cases.description: Add approval requests and protected feature access to a new Caffeine AI application.

use_cases.title: Secure Backend Operations
use_cases.description: Apply administrator and approval checks to public Motoko functions.

use_cases.title: Build Approval Interfaces
use_cases.description: Design user status screens and an administrator dashboard for reviewing access requests.

prompt_templates.title: Add Basic Approval
prompt_templates.prompt: Add the user approval extension to my Caffeine AI application. Identify prerequisites and outline the backend and frontend changes.

prompt_templates.title: Implement Backend Endpoints
prompt_templates.prompt: Integrate approval state into my Motoko actor. Add the required endpoints and protect administrator operations with authorization checks.

prompt_templates.title: Design the Approval Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a frontend approval flow for pending, approved, and rejected users. Include request access and administrator review states.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Full Approval Integration
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my complete Caffeine AI approval integration. Check every public function, administrator action, frontend state, and role interaction for authorization gaps.

output_examples.input: Plan approval support for a new Caffeine AI application.
output_examples.output: The plan installs the authorization prerequisite, initializes approval state, adds required endpoints, protects features, and builds user and administrator views.

output_examples.input: Review which backend actions need administrator protection.
output_examples.output: Approval decisions and approval-list access require administrator permission. Approval requests remain available to signed-in users, while protected features require approval.

output_examples.input: Describe the frontend states for an unapproved user.
output_examples.output: The interface checks current status, offers an approval request when appropriate, shows the latest state, and blocks protected features until approval.

best_practices: Complete the authorization extension before adding approval state.
Check authorization and approval on every protected public backend function.
Keep user status and administrator actions clear and consistent across the interface.
anti_patterns: Do not rely only on frontend visibility to protect backend functions.
Do not allow non-administrators to list users or change approval status.
Do not duplicate or modify the prefabricated approval module.

faq.question: What does this skill add?
faq.answer: It adds guidance for approval requests, administrator decisions, protected backend functions, and approval-aware frontend screens.

faq.question: Which prerequisite is required?
faq.answer: The Caffeine AI authorization extension must be integrated first.

faq.question: Can users approve themselves?
faq.answer: No. Users can request approval, but only administrators should change approval status.

faq.question: Are administrators subject to approval?
faq.answer: Administrators are automatically approved and should retain access to all application functionality.

faq.question: Can the approval module be customized?
faq.answer: No. The documented module is prefabricated and cannot be modified.

faq.question: Does the skill provide a complete frontend?
faq.answer: No. It defines required flows and dashboard capabilities, but the application must implement its own interface.
